question: Can pure price-volume (量价) factors -- no options, no news/short-interest, no fundamentals -- reach submit grade at D0 USA TOP3000?
verdict: NO. Pure PV caps at SH ~1.3 / FIT ~0.66 across 24 candidates in 3 batches. Passes CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT/turnover/sub-universe (dense by nature) but FAILS both regular (FIT>1.0) and competition (SH>2.0, FIT>1.3) gates. FITNESS is the binding constraint: PV reversal's inherent turnover caps FIT ~0.66 even when decayed.

best_pure_pv.note: 5-day reversal + low-volatility, subindustry-neutralized. Best of all pure-PV composites; still below grade.

signals_tested.decayed_reversal: SH 1.23, TO 0.31 -> FIT 0.66 (turnover lowered but FIT still capped)

why: D0 USA TOP3000 = large/mega-cap, highly efficient. Pure price-volume signals are weak and dominated by turnover cost. A submit-grade factor needs an orthogonal information backbone (short-interest squeeze, fundamentals, analyst, news, or options). In P0vp2jpx the price reversal IS the PV component; news_short_interest supplies the SH 2.0 / FIT 3+ backbone.
implication: If the deliverable must be a SUBMITTABLE factor, pure 量价 will not get there at D0 USA. Options: (a) PV + fundamentals/value hybrid (non-option), (b) accept P0vp2jpx (PV reversal + short-interest), (c) PV in a less-efficient universe/region.
